05/23.03.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

The applicants who are in custody since 02.10.2022 have approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with MGM P.S. Case No.97 of 2022, registered for the offence under Sections 384/ 387/ 419/ 420/ 468/ 476/ 471/ 120B of IPC.
It appears that the applicants have tried to defraud the informant by presenting themselves as Custom Commissioner.
It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of F.I.R. alongwith its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his part.
Innocence have been claimed and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that both the applicants are Transporters and they have good business.
In fact, Income Tax Return papers have been annexed showing that their annual income is more than Rs.14 lac.
On above basis prayer for bail has been made.
Learned A.P.P. and learned counsel for the informant have opposed the prayer for bail of the applicants.

Considering the above fact and the period of custody, the applicants, named above, are directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand only) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned J.M., Jamshedpur in connection with Pramjeet Singh @ Paramjit Singh vs The State Of Jharkhand ....
